description: Launch push: implement the approved design-system proposals (see design/proposals/) and surface seeded Steam-ban data in the UI.

userStories.title: Implement Report Card v2 (evidence-first)
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want report cards to lead with evidence and threat level so I can judge a report at a glance. Reference design: design/proposals/report-card-v2.html.
acceptanceCriteria: ReportCard shows an evidence thumbnail area with play affordance when evidence_url is a video/image, with a graceful fallback banner otherwise
Severity is rendered as a threat gauge/badge overlaying the evidence area (colors per DESIGN_SYSTEM.md severity tokens)
Hover state matches the proposal (lift, red border glow, play button scale)
Existing props/usages keep working; lint, typecheck and build pass
userStories.notes: Implemented in ReportCard.tsx: evidence thumbnail area with video/image/link/none detection from evidenceUrl, YouTube thumbnail extraction, conic-gradient threat gauge overlay using severity tokens, gradient fallback banner, glass-hover lift + red glow, play button scales on hover. Props interface unchanged.

userStories.title: Search-first Intel Board hero
userStories.description: As a server admin, I want to search a player name the moment I land so I can vet players fast. Reference design: design/proposals/hero-intel.html.
acceptanceCriteria: Home page hero has a prominent search input that routes to filtered Intel Board results
Live stat row (total, verified, games) driven by real API data with graceful loading state
userStories.notes: Implemented HeroSearch (routes to /intel?search=..., global / keypress focuses input), intel page seeds its search filter from the URL (wrapped in Suspense for useSearchParams), LiveStats rewritten to fetch total/verified/games from /api/reports with pulse loading skeletons, hero reworked to search-first layout per hero-intel.html.

userStories.title: Steam-ban provenance badge
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want imported Steam-ban reports clearly labelled so I can distinguish API-verified bans from community reports. Importer stamps tags ['steam-ban','auto-import'] and 'SteamID64: <id>' in the description (scripts/import-steam-bans.mjs).
acceptanceCriteria: Reports tagged steam-ban show a distinct 'Steam Ban on Record' badge on card and detail views
Detail view links to the Steam profile (evidence_url) and shows the attribution caveat from the description

userStories.title: Griefer profile page (aggregated reports)
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want a per-griefer page aggregating all their verified reports. Reference design: design/proposals/griefer-profile.html.
acceptanceCriteria: Route /griefer/[name] lists all verified reports for that griefer_name with count, games and severity summary
Report cards and detail pages link the griefer name to this page

userStories.title: Keyboard-first moderation queue
userStories.description: As a moderator, I want J/K navigation and V/R verify/reject shortcuts so triage takes under a minute per report. Reference design: design/proposals/moderation-queue.html.
acceptanceCriteria: Mod queue rows are focusable and navigable with J/K, with V=verify and R=reject invoking the existing status API
Visible keyboard hints in the queue header
Actions show optimistic UI updates with error rollback
